status: proposed internal orchestration; not a deployed integration

steps.gate: Contacts route D02 may be deferred if user supplies verified order contacts. Re-derive account hierarchy from authorized source responses; do not derive numbers by string manipulation.
The selected branch must belong to allowedBranchNumbers. Geographic search results alone are not account permission.
Selected SKU, ABC description, ordered UOM and quantity, dimensional length and warnings are explicit. Template/favorite/recommendation data is a starting point only.
Match selected item, selected branch and dimensional variation. Availability is not on-hand stock or promised delivery.

Every intended line has a successful matching result; prices, quantity, UOM, currency, Ship-To and branch remain bound. Fractional quantities cannot be rounded to satisfy pricing integer type. Zero price routes to branch pricing review under local policy, even if line status is OK.

Local policy requires reviewed address, contacts, delivery service/time, warnings, PO <=16, <=99 lines, current account/branch context and any required approval bound to exact payload hash. No inventory reservation or final-price guarantee is implied.

Atomically persist command key/hash before sending. Parse per-order results on 202. Same key/different payload is a local conflict. A transport timeout is indeterminate, not a failed order safe to repeat.
Keep a receipt visible while awaiting branch acceptance/ERP visibility. Bounded read retries and a local deadline may escalate; never resubmit merely because details are absent.

Invoice GET endpoints are gated off for third-party aggregator integrations by current docs. Invoice webhook eligibility and authentication must be verified independently; do not infer GET access from a received event.

background_workflows.policy: Full ingest, then ISO-8601 delta queries within 7 days. Apply Inactive tombstones. Checkpoint only completed runs; overlap watermarks and deduplicate locally if validated. Run full sync when stale beyond the documented lookback. Refresh availability before purchase.

Application administration. Max five registrations. Serialize changes, store secrets securely, reconcile ambiguous results by reads. Block invoice-event patch until D09 and auth until D10 are resolved.

rate_budgets.sandbox_budget_design: Conservative aggregate client-ID budget of 10 requests/second across APIs. Confirm exact window and burst behavior.
rate_budgets.design: Shared per-connection/application limiter across workers, with bounded concurrency and reserved interactive capacity; exact burst windows and latency SLAs are not established.

unsupported_remote_mutations: create/update/delete product master or branch master
reserve inventory or book a guaranteed delivery slot
unsupported_handling: Return UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION with documented alternatives and a branch/portal support handoff. Local draft edits are local CRUD and must not be represented as an ABC mutation.

exception_workflows.name: unpriced_or_custom_item
exception_workflows.provider_behavior: The public overview permits zero-price and custom-item submissions for branch review.
exception_workflows.local_policy: Separate reviewed exception, no automatic exact-catalog purchase; confirm custom description field and pricing expectations with the branch/provider.
